boundary_note: The columns name states, not changeover days: 2026/9時点 means "as of Sep 2026". The article dates the latest change to the March 2026 update (2026年3月のアップデートで…変更が入りました); its table is labelled 2026年3月12日(木) 更新, and page comments from 12-15 Mar 2026 describe the shorter faint pause. The Dec 2025 change is dated by the earliest retrieved page comments, 10-11 Dec 2025. Both boundaries are approximate. Values as of Sep 2026 are assumed to hold from the March update.
trigger_note: The charged row reads "enemy freeze time (immediately after a charged move activates)" and does not say whose charged move. The project owner reports from play that a charged attack from either side starts the pause, which agrees with cwizz1's "any charged move". Default any_charged; player_charged is an option.
trigger_grade: owner observation, agrees with cwizz1; not measured

cwizz1.quote: It's actually 7 turns after any charged move or switch. On your own switch, it's functionally 6 turns because switching takes 1 turn.
cwizz1.quote_basis: Retrieved from the thread archive (Arctic Shift); the quote is exact.
cwizz1.own_switch_note: Stored as 6 from "functionally 6 turns"; no voluntary switches are simulated.

timer.charged_quote: 7s are added per charge move used
timer.interpretation: Use these approximate measurements as exact model parameters. Each resolved charged attack, on either side, including shielded attacks, extends the turn deadline. No animation turns are added.
timer.previous_quote: Previously, a timeout vs the Rocket Leaders counts as a loss.
timer.era_note: Measured once in the Dec 2025 era and assumed unchanged since. Before Dec 2025 a leader timeout is a loss, per the same post; the older timer length and the older grunt timeout rule are not sourced, so they reuse the current values.

faint_note: The faint row reads "enemy freeze time (immediately after a swap caused by a faint)" and does not say whose Pokemon fainted. The project owner reads it as either side's faint and replacement; rocket_replacement is the narrower option.
composition_note: A charged-move pause starts after PvPoke's post-charge turn without input, so the two add: a charge resolving on t blocks Rocket inputs t+1 (core) and t+2..t+N+1 (pause). cwizz1: "7 turns means you throw after 6 turns of fast moves"; Jason2890: "6 turns is the maximum number of turns you can take between charge moves to ensure the rocket (or team leader) does not use any fast moves".
extension_note: The charged trigger and the summed composition rest on Mar 2026 era accounts (cwizz1, Aug 2026, and the owner's play). Earlier eras apply them by extension, and their grades say so.
